_receipt_facts: VERIFIED 2026-10-19: Stoughton Chamber of Commerce (stoughtonwi.com) says it hosts 'the largest Syttende Mai celebration in the United States'; Wikipedia (Stoughton, Wisconsin, citing Milwaukee Magazine) says the city is 'known for its Norwegian heritage' with a citywide Syttende Mai; UW-Madison Center for the Study of Upper Midwestern Cultures (folklife.wisc.edu, 'A Style of Their Own: Upper Midwestern Rosemalers') says 'Dane County in Wisconsin, and Stoughton in particular, is a center of Rogaland style' and 'Typically a symmetrical design of baroque scrolls and acanthus leaves are arranged around a central flower.' Rosemaling = Norwegian decorative folk painting with C and S scrolls, acanthus, flowers (Vesterheim, Wikipedia Rose-painting).
